# Overview

Computes each male's proximity network position during his OWN juvenile
period (natal group, up to 1 year before `juvenile_period_end`), as
opposed to script 2's post-dispersal window. Reuses
`compute_metrics_from_posterior()` from `bison_prox_net_script.R`
unchanged — only the window/group selection differs, via a new
`extract_male_network_metrics_juvenile()` wrapper.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(igraph)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

data_dir <- "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Data"

emigrants <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "All_potential_immigrants_Josie_version.csv"))
scans     <- read.csv("/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/IVP_data/scans/scans_for_bison.csv")
source(file.path(data_dir, "..", "Analyses", "scan_extraction_1mandarm.R"))
```

# Build the juvenile window

```{r build-juvenile-window}
# natal_group     = BirthGp (as opposed to ImmigrationGp1 post-dispersal)
# window          = DOB + 365 days (excludes the infant year) through
#                   dispersal (DateImmigration1, falling back to
#                   DepartureNatalGp when DateImmigration1 is missing,
#                   consistent with the dispersal-date convention used
#                   elsewhere in the pipeline, e.g. elo_rating_male_calculator.R)
# This is the FULL span, not clipped to a fixed length — unlike the
# post-dispersal window (fixed at 1 year post-immigration), the
# juvenile period is naturally variable in length across males.
build_juvenile_window <- function(emigrants) {
  emigrants %>%
    mutate(
      DOB              = as.Date(DOB),
      DateImmigration1 = as.Date(DateImmigration1),
      DepartureNatalGp = as.Date(DepartureNatalGp),
      natal_group      = BirthGp,
      dispersal_date   = if_else(!is.na(DateImmigration1), DateImmigration1, DepartureNatalGp),
      juvenile_window_start = DOB + 365,
      juvenile_window_end   = dispersal_date
    )
}

emigrants_juv <- build_juvenile_window(emigrants)

cat("Males who dispersed before turning 1 year old (window invalid - start > end):\n")
emigrants_juv %>%
  filter(!is.na(juvenile_window_start), !is.na(juvenile_window_end),
         juvenile_window_start >= juvenile_window_end) %>%
  select(Code, DOB, dispersal_date, juvenile_window_start, juvenile_window_end) %>%
  print()

# Guard against the invalid case above producing a negative-length window
emigrants_juv <- emigrants_juv %>%
  mutate(
    juvenile_window_start = if_else(juvenile_window_start < juvenile_window_end,
                                     juvenile_window_start, as.Date(NA)),
    juvenile_window_end   = if_else(!is.na(juvenile_window_start), juvenile_window_end, as.Date(NA))
  )

cat("\nDistribution of juvenile window length (days), among valid windows:\n")
print(summary(as.numeric(emigrants_juv$juvenile_window_end - emigrants_juv$juvenile_window_start)))

cat("\nMales missing natal_group / window entirely:\n")
emigrants_juv %>%
  summarise(
    n_total              = n(),
    n_has_natal_group    = sum(!is.na(natal_group)),
    n_has_window_start   = sum(!is.na(juvenile_window_start)),
    n_has_window_end     = sum(!is.na(juvenile_window_end))
  ) %>% print()
```

# Helper: compute network metrics from Beta posterior samples

Identical to `bison_prox_net_script.R` — reused unchanged, since this
function doesn't know or care whether the network being summarised is
the natal or the destination network.

```{r compute-metrics-function}
compute_metrics_from_posterior <- function(dyadic_data, all_nodes, focal_node,
                                           num_draws = 1000,
                                           prior_a = 0.1, prior_b = 0.1,
                                           edge_thresh = 0.0001) {

  n_dyads <- nrow(dyadic_data)
  n_nodes <- length(all_nodes)

  draw_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_dyads, ncol = num_draws)
  for (d in 1:n_dyads) {
    draw_mat[d, ] <- rbeta(num_draws,
                           prior_a + dyadic_data$event[d],
                           prior_b + dyadic_data$duration[d] - dyadic_data$event[d])
  }

  node1 <- as.character(dyadic_data$node_1)
  node2 <- as.character(dyadic_data$node_2)

  strength_draws <- numeric(num_draws)
  degree_draws   <- numeric(num_draws)

  for (k in 1:num_draws) {

    adj <- matrix(0, n_nodes, n_nodes, dimnames = list(all_nodes, all_nodes))
    for (r in 1:n_dyads) {
      w <- draw_mat[r, k]
      if (w < edge_thresh) w <- 0
      adj[node1[r], node2[r]] <- w
      adj[node2[r], node1[r]] <- w
    }

    g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE)

    strength_draws[k] <- igraph::strength(g)[focal_node]
    # Juvenile windows can span multiple years, so group membership turns
    # over - median daily group size can be smaller than the cumulative
    # network. Normalizing by n_nodes - 1 (the network's own observed
    # size) avoids that mismatch entirely; degree can never exceed
    # n_nodes - 1 by construction, so this is always in [0, 1].
    degree_draws[k]   <- igraph::degree(g)[focal_node] / (n_nodes - 1)
  }

  list(strength_draws = strength_draws, degree_draws = degree_draws)
}
```

# New wrapper: extract juvenile-window network metrics

Same body as `extract_male_network_metrics()` in `bison_prox_net_script.R`,
with `group_name`/`start_date`/`end_date` sourced from `natal_group` /
`juvenile_window_start` / `juvenile_window_end` instead of
`ImmigrationGp1` / `DateImmigration1` / `+365`.

```{r extract-juvenile-metrics-function}
extract_male_network_metrics_juvenile <- function(scans, emigrants_juv, num_draws = 1000) {

  contact_behaviours <- c(
    "allogrooming: groom", "allogrooming: being groomed",
    "affiliative: sit in contact", "affiliative: mouth to mouth",
    "affiliative: nurse", "affiliative: infant handling",
    "groom", "being groomed", "mouth to mouth", "mouth fed from",
    "feed from mouth", "nurse", "infant handle", "play-mount",
    "gr", "bgr", "mc", "bmc", "pm", "bpm", "sm", "bsm",
    "to", "bto", "ca", "em", "nu", "ih", "ii", "sg",
    "bite", "being bitten", "hit", "being hit", "grab",
    "hand on head", "hand on top of head (hh)", "attack", "chase",
    "fm", "bfm", "gb", "bgb", "bi", "bbi", "hi", "bhi",
    "fi", "hh", "bhh", "so", "bso",
    "sexual: mount", "sexual: be-mounted", "sexual: being mounted",
    "sexual: inspect", "sexual: solicit", "sexual: be solicited",
    "play: sexual", "mu", "bmu", "hg", "bhg", "bs", "bbs"
  )

  results <- list()
  posterior_draws <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(emigrants_juv))) {

    male_code  <- emigrants_juv$Code[i]
    group_name <- emigrants_juv$natal_group[i]
    start_date <- emigrants_juv$juvenile_window_start[i]
    end_date   <- emigrants_juv$juvenile_window_end[i]

    if (any(is.na(c(male_code, group_name, start_date, end_date)))) {
      message("Skipping ", male_code, " - missing required data")
      next
    }

    scans_filtered <- scans %>%
      mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
      filter(group_Abbreviation == group_name,
             !is.na(date),
             date >= start_date,
             date <= end_date)

    if (nrow(scans_filtered) == 0) {
      message("No scan data for male ", male_code, " (juvenile window)")
      next
    }

    scans_filtered$year <- as.numeric(format(scans_filtered$date, "%Y"))
    proximity_data <- extract_proximity_pairs(scans_filtered)

    if (is.null(proximity_data) || nrow(proximity_data) == 0) {
      message("No proximity data for male ", male_code, " (juvenile window)")
      next
    }

    from_focal <- scans_filtered %>%
      filter(!is.na(idindividual1) & idindividual1 != "") %>%
      mutate(
        is_contact    = trimws(tolower(behaviour))     %in% contact_behaviours |
          trimws(tolower(behaviourtype)) %in% contact_behaviours,
        has_proximity = (!is.na(ind1m)        & ind1m        != "") |
          (!is.na(indarmlength) & indarmlength != "") |
          (!is.na(nnadult)      & nnadult      != "") |
          (!is.na(nnjuvenile)   & nnjuvenile   != ""),
        exclude       = is_contact & !has_proximity
      ) %>%
      filter(!exclude) %>%
      distinct(idindividual1, scan_id) %>%
      rename(individual = idindividual1)

    from_proximity <- proximity_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(interaction_partner) & interaction_partner != "") %>%
      distinct(interaction_partner, scan_id) %>%
      rename(individual = interaction_partner)

    individual_scan_counts <- bind_rows(from_focal, from_proximity) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      group_by(individual) %>%
      summarise(scans_sampled = n_distinct(scan_id), .groups = "drop")

    dyadic_data <- proximity_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(idindividual1) & idindividual1 != "",
             !is.na(interaction_partner) & interaction_partner != "") %>%
      mutate(
        node_1 = pmin(idindividual1, interaction_partner),
        node_2 = pmax(idindividual1, interaction_partner)
      ) %>%
      filter(node_1 != node_2) %>%
      group_by(node_1, node_2) %>%
      summarise(event = n_distinct(scan_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(individual_scan_counts, by = c("node_1" = "individual")) %>%
      rename(scans_node_1 = scans_sampled) %>%
      left_join(individual_scan_counts, by = c("node_2" = "individual")) %>%
      rename(scans_node_2 = scans_sampled) %>%
      mutate(
        duration = scans_node_1 + scans_node_2 - event,
        sri      = event / duration
      )

    if (nrow(dyadic_data) == 0 ||
        !male_code %in% c(dyadic_data$node_1, dyadic_data$node_2)) {
      message("Male ", male_code, " has no dyads in juvenile network")
      next
    }

    all_nodes <- unique(c(dyadic_data$node_1, dyadic_data$node_2))

    tryCatch({

      metrics <- compute_metrics_from_posterior(
        dyadic_data = dyadic_data,
        all_nodes   = all_nodes,
        focal_node  = male_code,
        num_draws   = num_draws,
        prior_a     = 0.1,
        prior_b     = 0.1
      )

      posterior_draws[[male_code]] <- list(
        prox_strength_juv = metrics$strength_draws,
        prox_degree_juv   = metrics$degree_draws
      )

      male_dyads     <- dyadic_data %>%
        filter(node_1 == male_code | node_2 == male_code)
      strength_assoc <- sum(male_dyads$sri)

      results[[i]] <- tibble(
        Code             = male_code,
        natal_group      = group_name,
        window_start     = start_date,
        window_end       = end_date,
        strength_mean    = mean(metrics$strength_draws),
        strength_lower   = quantile(metrics$strength_draws, 0.025),
        strength_upper   = quantile(metrics$strength_draws, 0.975),
        degree_mean      = mean(metrics$degree_draws),
        degree_lower     = quantile(metrics$degree_draws, 0.025),
        degree_upper     = quantile(metrics$degree_draws, 0.975),
        strength_assoc   = strength_assoc,
        n_dyads          = nrow(dyadic_data),
        n_scans          = individual_scan_counts$scans_sampled[
          individual_scan_counts$individual == male_code]
      )

      message("Done (juvenile): ", male_code, " (", group_name, ")")

    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Metric extraction error for male ", male_code, " (juvenile): ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
  }

  summaries <- bind_rows(results)
  list(summaries = summaries, posteriors = posterior_draws)
}
```

# Run and save

```{r run-juvenile-proximity}
prox_results_juv <- extract_male_network_metrics_juvenile(scans, emigrants_juv, num_draws = 1000)

write.csv(prox_results_juv$summaries,
          file.path(data_dir, "network_mets_prox_bayes_juvenile.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(prox_results_juv$posteriors,
        file.path(data_dir, "prox_posteriors_juvenile.rds"))

cat("Juvenile proximity done.", length(prox_results_juv$posteriors), "males with posteriors saved.\n")
```

```{r}
emigrants_juv %>%
  filter(!is.na(BirthGp)) %>%   # restrict to natal males, where this should matter
  mutate(
    missing_natal_group = is.na(natal_group),
    missing_start        = is.na(juvenile_window_start),
    missing_end          = is.na(juvenile_window_end)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total               = n(),
    n_missing_natal_group = sum(missing_natal_group),
    n_missing_start       = sum(missing_start),
    n_missing_end         = sum(missing_end),
    n_any_missing         = sum(missing_natal_group | missing_start | missing_end)
  ) %>% print()

# If n_missing_start is high, this tells you why:
emigrants_juv %>%
  filter(!is.na(BirthGp), is.na(juvenile_window_start)) %>%
  select(Code, DOB, DateImmigration1, DepartureNatalGp, dispersal_date) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
emigrants_juv %>%
  filter(!is.na(BirthGp), !is.na(natal_group),
         !is.na(juvenile_window_start), !is.na(juvenile_window_end)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_scans_in_window = sum(
      as.Date(scans$date) >= juvenile_window_start &
      as.Date(scans$date) <= juvenile_window_end &
      scans$group_Abbreviation == natal_group,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    n_valid_window   = n(),
    n_zero_scans     = sum(n_scans_in_window == 0),
    n_some_scans     = sum(n_scans_in_window > 0)
  ) %>% print()
```
